components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gradient-border action: raised-ground fill, 1px cyan→blue→violet edge, blue glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0.85rem 1.9rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--display, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--text, #e8edf8); text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(var(--bg-raise, #0a1120), var(--bg-raise, #0a1120)) padding-box, linear-gradient(120deg, var(--cyan, #45e0e0), var(--blue, #3e6dff) 45%, var(--violet, #8a5cff)) border-box; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: box-shadow 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 28px -6px rgba(62, 109, 255, 0.55); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #45e0e0); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Arrow Link
components.description: Secondary text action with an appended cyan arrow; hover lifts to full text color. Back variant leads with a cyan left arrow.
components.html: Meet the team All news
components.css: .ds-link-arrow, .ds-link-back { font-family: var(--display, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--text-2, #9fadc9); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; margin-right: 1.5rem; } .ds-link-arrow::after { content: ' \2192'; color: var(--cyan, #45e0e0); } .ds-link-back::before { content: '\2190  '; color: var(--cyan, #45e0e0); } .ds-link-arrow:hover, .ds-link-back:hover { color: var(--text, #e8edf8); } .ds-link-arrow:focus-visible, .ds-link-back:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #45e0e0); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; background: var(--bg, #060a13); padding: 1rem 1.5rem; } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: var(--display, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.28em; color: var(--text, #e8edf8); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav-links a { font-family: var(--body, 'Public Sans', Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 550; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-2, #9fadc9); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--cyan, #45e0e0); } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #45e0e0); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-roster-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(0,0.85fr); gap: 1rem 2rem; align-items: center; padding: 1.4rem 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(126,154,220,0.16); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(126,154,220,0.16); background: var(--bg, #060a13); font-family: var(--body, 'Public Sans', Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-avatar { display: block; width: 64px; height: 64px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--cyan, #45e0e0), var(--blue, #3e6dff) 45%, var(--violet, #8a5cff)); } .ds-avatar-img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-raise, #0a1120); } .ds-roster-name { font-family: var(--display, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.45rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--text, #e8edf8); } .ds-roster-focus { color: var(--text-2, #9fadc9); font-size: 0.98rem; } .ds-roster-inst { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 550; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--text-2, #9fadc9); text-align: right; }

components.name: Institution Logo Strip

components.css: .ds-inst-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1.5rem 3.5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--bg, #060a13); padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-inst-strip svg { height: 30px; width: auto; filter: grayscale(1) brightness(0) invert(1); opacity: 0.45; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-inst-strip a:hover svg { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Magnet-Card Frame
components.description: The signature 1px gradient ring (mask-composite technique) with edge-breaking Title Case label and N/S pole marks; the homepage hero is this at viewport scale (capped at 1560px).
components.html: An ARPA-E MAGNITO ProjectNSGAMBIT
components.css: .ds-card-frame { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 200px; background: var(--bg, #060a13); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-card-frame::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 14px; border-radius: 18px; padding: 1px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(69,224,224,0.8), rgba(62,109,255,0.45) 40%, rgba(138,92,255,0.7)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events: none; } .ds-card-program { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: var(--bg, #060a13); padding: 0.15rem 0.8rem; font-family: var(--body, 'Public Sans', Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 550; letter-spacing: 0.09em; color: var(--text-2, #9fadc9); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-card-pole { position: absolute; font-family: var(--display, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-card-pole.ds-n { top: 22px; left: 26px; color: var(--pole-n, #e08585); } .ds-card-pole.ds-s { bottom: 22px; right: 26px; color: var(--pole-s, #7d9be8); transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-card-word { font-family: var(--display, 'Public Sans', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; margin-right: -0.16em; color: var(--text, #e8edf8); }

narrative.overview:
The site's world is the project's logo turned inside out: the visitor lands inside the emblem's magnet card, scaled to the viewport — 1px gradient frame, warm-N / cool-S pole marks in opposite corners, the knight mark centered, cyan field lines radiating slowly behind everything. Every other surface derives from that card. It deliberately refuses the dark-SaaS default (gradient blob, centered pitch, three feature cards) in favor of a single continuous instrument: near-black ground, hairline rules instead of boxes, and color that appears almost exclusively as thin strokes of light.

The tone is institutional and investor-grade: a serious, funded, multi-institution research effort. Density is low and typographic — generous vertical space, long readable measures, wide-tracked capitals reserved for identity moments, quiet muted text for everything secondary. There is no stock imagery and no photography beyond the 64px team headshots; the pictures are the knight SVG, gray institution logos, and line-drawn scientific diagrams in the world's own stroke language.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (#060a13) with light carried in 1px cyan→blue→violet gradient strokes
The magnet card as the master container: full-viewport frame on the homepage (capped at 1560px), 2px gradient top rule on inner pages
N/S pole marks as corner punctuation (warm coral top-left, cool periwinkle bottom-right, rotated 180°)
Public Sans tracked caps for identity, Public Sans for reading; small labels in Title Case, not uppercase
Structure by hairline rules and grids; the single filled surface is the full-bleed raised news band
Motion that is barely perceptible: a 240s field-ray rotation, one entrance rise, all honoring prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The Thin Light Rule
rules.body: The gradient and its component hues appear as 1px–2.2px strokes, small glyphs, micro-labels, and thin rings — never as area fills, gradient text, or background washes. The allowed soft fills are the faint radial glows behind the hero rays and the loop disc (≤22% alpha).

rules.name: The One Warm Note Rule
rules.body: The N pole coral (#e08585) is the only warm color in the system and appears only as the N pole mark. Do not promote it to a general accent, error color, or highlight.

rules.name: The Stage Hue Rule
rules.body: Discovery-loop stages carry per-stage stroke icons: Predict cyan (#45E0E0), Synthesize blue (#3E6DFF), Validate violet (#8A5CFF), Learn mid-blue (#5F7FFF). New stage-like sequences should sample along the same cyan→violet axis.

rules.name: The Mask Plumbing Rule
rules.body: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) inside mask / -webkit-mask declarations (the .hero-frame gradient-ring technique) is mask alpha plumbing — an opaque coverage layer, not a black in the palette. Never extract it as a color token.

rules.name: The Title Case Label Rule
rules.body: Small labels — news dates, institution names, program attribution, footer meta — are set in Title Case with modest tracking (0.04–0.09em) at Public Sans 550. Uppercase survives in exactly three places: nav links, the hero acronym line, and brand lockups (Public Sans, 0.26–0.28em tracking). Do not add new all-caps eyebrow labels. (Amended 2026-08-10, user direction.)

rules.name: The 550 Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Emphasis inside muted body text is Public Sans weight 550 in full text color (#e8edf8), not bold, not an accent color. Italic + cyan is reserved for the single mission-line emphasis.

rules.name: The Frame Inset Rule
rules.body: Everything that sits on or near the card edge (frame, poles, program label, hero nav padding) derives from --frame-inset; adjust the one token, never the individual offsets.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Any box-shadow must be a colored, blurred glow in the element's own hue; never a neutral/black offset shadow. Surfaces are flat at rest; glow is a response to state or a marker of energy.

rules.name: The One Step Up Rule
rules.body: Raised surfaces climb the tonal ladder one rung at a time (ground → ground-raise → surface) and announce themselves with a hairline top edge, never a shadow.

dos: Do derive every new surface from the magnet-card world: ground #060a13, hairline structure, gradient strokes, pole-mark corner punctuation.

Do use the mask-composite gradient-ring technique (.hero-frame), the padding-box/border-box gradient border (.btn), and the gradient-padding ring (.avatar) whenever a gradient stroke is needed; never fake it with a wrapper div and inner fill.
Do draw new diagrams and icons as 1–2.2px stroke SVGs, round caps/joins, in the brand gradient or single stage hues; the loop figure and stage icons are the reference.
Do set new small labels in Title Case at Public Sans 550 with 0.04–0.09em tracking (The Title Case Label Rule); uppercase only in nav, acronym line, and brand lockups.
Do neutralize any external logo through the .inst-strip filter chain (white, 0.45 opacity) before it touches the ground.
Do publish news by copying news/_template.html and adding entries to the homepage and archive lists — static HTML, no build step, minimal vanilla JS only (PRODUCT.md constraint).
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for any new animation, and keep motion glacial and ambient (the 240s ray rotation is the ceiling of the site's energy).
Do keep the roster and news grids extensible: new PIs, team members, and posts are new hairline rows, never a redesign.
donts: Don't group content with bordered cards or floating panels; hairline rules on transparent ground are the container, with the full-bleed raised band (ground-raise + hairline top) as the only fill (The One Step Up Rule).
Don't use neutral offset drop shadows; glow in the element's own hue only (The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule).
Don't use the gradient as a text fill or an area fill; it lives in strokes and rings (The Thin Light Rule).
Don't introduce warm colors beyond the N-pole coral, or use the pole colors outside the pole marks (The One Warm Note Rule).
Don't read linear-gradient(#000 0 0) in mask declarations as a color; it is mask alpha plumbing (The Mask Plumbing Rule).
Don't reuse the loop diagram's steel grays for UI; they are material rendering scoped to that illustration.
Don't use stock imagery or AI-cliché visuals (user-pinned in PRODUCT.md); the knight, headshots, gray logos, and line-drawn diagrams are the imagery.

Don't add a .nojekyll file to this repo. The content-policy exclusion (PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, docs/, README.md never published to projectgambit.org) depends on GitHub Pages' Jekyll processing staying enabled via _config.yml's exclude list; .nojekyll would re-publish these internal files. Internal docs must never contain the excluded program names/numbers (see PRODUCT.md Capabilities and Constraints).
